title: Dispatch: spellcasting sections + retire cantrips/spellbook artifact features (attempt 1)
description:
Implementation dispatch for parent eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2.4 (read its DESIGN + NOTES first: `bd show eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2.4`). Worktree `.worktrees/eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2.4.1`, branch `eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2.4.1`. Follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. All paths below are relative to packages/core.

GOAL: one feature record per printed class feature; each class Spellcasting / Pact Magic record carries its printed 12pt subsections as verbatim `data.sections: [{ name, text }]`; the 5 parser-artifact records disappear.

ROOT CAUSE (verified): scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseFeatures.ts `featureStartAt` falls back to `leadingLevelFromFollowingLines` (LEVEL_LEAD_IN, "At 1st level, ...") for CLASS grantors too, so the 12pt subheadings "Cantrips" (cleric p15, druid p20, sorcerer p43, wizard p52) and "Spellbook" (wizard p52) become features. They are the ONLY class-grantor features not anchored by a class progression featureGrant (checked against the committed pack). Bard/Warlock Cantrips bodies lack the lead-in, hence the inconsistency. scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/classProgression.ts `SPELLCASTING_SECTION_MOVES` + `canonicalizeSpellcastingFeatureDescriptions` (eshyra-o9bd.4) then copied their text back into the owner.

PRINTED DENOMINATOR (real extraction; feature heading height 13.9, subheading 12.0, body 9.8; the Spellcasting body ends at the next >=13.5 line). 39 subsections:
- Bard p11-12: Cantrips | Spell Slots | Spells Known of 1st Level and Higher | Spellcasting Ability | Ritual Casting | Spellcasting Focus
- Cleric p15-16 and Druid p19-20: Cantrips | Preparing and Casting Spells | Spellcasting Ability | Ritual Casting | Spellcasting Focus
- Paladin p31: Preparing and Casting Spells | Spellcasting Ability | Spellcasting Focus
- Ranger p36: Spell Slots | Spells Known of 1st Level and Higher | Spellcasting Ability
- Sorcerer p43 and Warlock "Pact Magic" p46-47: Cantrips | Spell Slots | Spells Known of 1st Level and Higher | Spellcasting Ability | Spellcasting Focus
- Wizard p52-53: Cantrips | Spellbook | Preparing and Casting Spells | Spellcasting Ability | Ritual Casting | Spellcasting Focus | Learning Spells of 1st Level and Higher
Other class features have 12pt lines too (Fighting Style options, Metamagic, Pact Boon, Ki, Font of Magic, Channel Divinity, Divine Domain). They are OUT OF SCOPE: do not change them.

DECISIONS (made by the supervisor; do not re-decide):
D1 parseFeatures: the prose-lead-in fallback applies ONLY to subclass grantors. Class features come only from class-table anchors. Expected effect on the real pack: exactly the 5 records feature:{cleric,druid,sorcerer,wizard}:cantrips and feature:wizard:spellbook disappear. If any other feature record appears or disappears, STOP and report it in notes (do not paper over it). Update uniform-font fixtures/tests that relied on class-grantor prose fallback only if they model a non-table subheading; keep a parser test proving a class-context "Cantrips" subheading with an "At 1st level" body is NOT promoted.
D2 Sections: add to FeatureExtraction (types.ts) optional `sections?: readonly { name: string; text: string }[]`. In parseFeatures, for a CLASS-grantor feature named exactly `Spellcasting` or `Pact Magic` (a named constant with a comment explaining why only these two), when heading tiers are present (`tiersPresent`), split the body at subheading-tier lines (height in the 12pt tier, i.e. above body and below the 13.9 feature tier; reuse or add a tier predicate next to the existing ones in parseSubclasses.ts, such as hasHeadingTiers/isCalloutBoxHeading). Text before the first subheading becomes `description`. Each subheading becomes `{ name: <heading line>, text: joinParagraphs(its body lines) }`, in print order, verbatim. On uniform-font fixtures (no tiers), keep today's behavior: no sections and the full body as description. No text may be duplicated between description and sections, and no text may be lost: description + sections must reconstruct the body.
D3 emit.ts buildFeatureData: field order source, level, description, sections?, optionCatalog?, mechanics?, choices?. src/rules/kindSchemas.ts validateDnd5eFeature: optional `sections`, a non-empty array of { name: non-empty string, text: non-empty string } (mirror the subclass sections validator). fieldProvenanceDeclarations.ts: `namedEntry('feature', '/sections', { mechanics: false })` next to the subclass one.
D4 Anything that today reads the spellcasting feature description must see the SAME full text as before. Add one helper that reconstructs the full body (description, then each `${name} ${text}`, space-joined the way joinParagraphs joined the heading lines before), and use it wherever mechanics/choices/facts are derived from a feature description: deriveFeatureMechanics in emit.ts, deriveFeatureChoices.ts (see ':spellcasting'/':pact-magic' near line 263), creationFacts.ts and its fidelity checks, and sourceInventoryCoverage.ts ownership (SPELLCASTING_BOILERPLATE / SPELLCASTING_BOILERPLATE_OWNER near lines 1100 and 1535: all 39 subheadings are now owned by the class's spellcasting/pact-magic record via sections, including Cantrips, Spell Slots, Spellbook and Spellcasting Ability). Acceptance: `data.mechanics` on the 8 spellcasting/pact-magic records is byte-identical to origin/main.
D5 Delete SPELLCASTING_SECTION_MOVES, canonicalizeSpellcastingFeatureDescriptions and their helpers (keep a helper only if another caller still uses it) from classProgression.ts.
D6 deriveFeatureChoices.ts (~line 394): the spellbook-initial / spellbook-growth choices move onto feature:wizard:spellcasting, with ids and content unchanged, appended after the existing cantrips and prepared-spells choices. Update test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/deriveFeatureChoices.test.ts (~370) and test/srdPlayableSmoke.test.ts (~291) to the new owner.
D7 Retired keys (runtime lookup, src/rules): in src/rules/lookup.ts lookupRulesRecord, when a `ref` is not found, consult an exported `RETIRED_RECORD_KEY_ALIASES: ReadonlyMap<string, string>` (the 5 retired keys mapped to feature:<class>:spellcasting) and return the canonical record. Comment it with the bead id and why (pre-existing references resolve; the canonical key is authoritative). In src/rules/stack.ts recordLookupNames, for kind 'feature', also add each `data.sections[].name`, so a name lookup of "Cantrips" or "Spellbook" returns the owning spellcasting record(s): ambiguous with candidateKeys when several classes print it, which is correct. Add tests for both paths in the existing lookup/stack tests.
D8 Importer gate: new scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/spellcastingSections.ts modeled on toolsTableRows.ts and creatureAttackLeadIns.ts (read both). Wire it into index.ts runImporter right after assertToolsTableRowParity, with `requireComplete: input.assertDeclarationsAreLive === true`. It must work independently of parseFeatures:
  (a) Scan the source pages for lines exactly `Spellcasting` or `Pact Magic` at the 13.9 feature tier (use lineHeights). Attribute each to its class by the nearest preceding class chapter heading line, i.e. a line equal to a `class` record's name at the chapter heading tier (check the real heights; the parser's isParentClassHeading tier is a reference). Collect the subheading-tier lines until the next line at or above the feature tier. Compare that ordered name list to the emitted record's `data.sections[].name` exactly. Report missing, extra and reordered names.
  (b) Every feature record whose data.source is class:* must be referenced by a featureGrant or featureImprovement in that class's data.progression (the class-table membership denominator).
  requireComplete: all 8 casters must be found. Unit tests (fixtures, not the PDF), like test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/toolsTableRows.test.ts: pass case, a missing section, an extra section, a reorder, an unanchored class feature, and requireComplete with no caster found.
D9 Regenerate: `npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1` (run from the worktree root). Then `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack` must say exact match. Regenerate the dependent inventories whose tests pin pack content (npx tsx packages/core/scripts/inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts, npx tsx packages/core/scripts/inventory-equipment-mechanics.ts if affected, then `npx biome format --write` on any regenerated docs JSON). Update the pinned expectations that change because of THIS change, and in each updated comment explain why: record counts (-5 feature records), test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts (~721, ~2473, 2510-2534, ~2663, ~7488), scripts/create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/cli.ts (~1269, feature:wizard:cantrips), provenance-partition counts, and the audit-bundle numbers. The long-rest `mechanics.resources` on the removed cantrips/spellbook records disappear with them. Do NOT re-home them (opus:F-05 belongs to eshyra-o9bd.19.3.2). Do not weaken any other expectation. If an unrelated expectation breaks, stop and report it. Update scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/README.md (the feature row: the sections rule and the gate). Leave historical thaw notes under docs/audits untouched.
Add a committed-pack test in test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts: the 5 retired keys are absent. feature:wizard:spellcasting sections names equal the wizard list above, and its description is only the intro ("As a student of arcane magic, ..."). feature:warlock:pact-magic has 5 sections. No description contains a section's text.

COMPLETION PROOF (record it in your notes): `npm run verify:worktree` green (numbers). `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack` exact. The record diff vs origin/main: only the 5 removals and the 8 spellcasting/pact-magic records changed (description split + sections; choices moved on wizard). Mechanics are unchanged (show how you checked). Negative proof: temporarily revert the parseFeatures D1 change and show the gate (b) fails naming the 5 keys, then restore.

ENVIRONMENT: the host has ~7 GB RAM. Run one vitest/verify at a time. Use `npx vitest run <files>` for focused runs. `npm ci` in the worktree first.
